summary_en: 19,500 shares (3.0% of S/O ex-treasury) | ¥26.3M upper limit | Reference price ¥1,350/share | ToSTNeT-3 method | Settlement 2026-07-16 post-market | Capital efficiency and flexible capital policy rationale
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: SMS Data Tech Corporation announced on 2026-07-15 that its board approved a single-block treasury stock purchase via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 2026-07-16. The company will acquire up to 19,500 ordinary shares (3.0% of the 650,000 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of 2026-05-31) for a total outlay not to exceed ¥26.325 million. The reference price is ¥1,350 per share. The buy order is placed for the 08:45 JST trading window only on 2026-07-16, with results to be announced immediately post-execution. Full or partial non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. The stated rationale is to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital policy execution. Treasury holdings as of 2026-05-31 were zero shares.
